plugin.note: Phase 2 airborne form has Protect from Melee active as defence only. Tumeken's shadow can zero-switch both phases; otherwise ranged is preferred.

requirements: Use Slayer helmet (i) when killing her on a Kalphite task with Magic or Ranged.
Bring phase-one melee gear unless using a zero-switch Shadow setup.
mechanics: The airborne second form has Protect from Melee active as a defence indicator rather than full immunity.
The airborne form has much lower Magic and Ranged defence than melee defence.
Tumeken's shadow can be used as a low-switch approach for both forms.
Ranged weapons are a common alternative for the airborne form.

methods.label: Phase 2 Magic or Ranged
methods.summary: Use Tumeken's shadow or a ranged weapon for the airborne form after the crawling form dies.
recommendedFor: players using Magic or Ranged switches
steps: After the crawling form dies, wait through the transformation into the airborne form.
Use Tumeken's shadow for the Magic approach, especially if using a low-switch setup.
Use Toxic blowpipe, Twisted bow, or Bow of faerdhinen as ranged alternatives.
Keep Protect from Magic active and heal before falling below 31 Hitpoints.
notes: This JSON migrates the previous Kalphite Queen airborne-form Markdown strategy.

methods.label: Phase 2 walk-under
methods.summary: Walk under the Queen as soon as phase two begins, then attack with Shadow, magic, or ranged while limiting extra attacks.
recommendedFor: players reducing incoming damage between attacks
steps: As the airborne form appears, walk under the Queen before she gets an extra attack.
Step out to attack with Tumeken's shadow, Eye of ayak, or ranged weapons.
Step back under when eating or when waiting for the next attack cycle.
Use a DPS calculator or local gear knowledge to decide whether melee is accurate enough; magic or ranged is usually preferred.
risks: Her ranged and magic attacks always roll successful hits.
Nearby cocoons can hatch Kalphite Workers when the Queen is hit.
notes: Protect from Magic remains preferred in phase two.
Magic can be used for both phases with Shadow to reduce switches.

styleOptions.label: Magic Shadow
styleOptions.summary: Magic setup for the airborne form using Tumeken's shadow or Eye of ayak.

styleOptions.label: Ranged alternative
styleOptions.summary: Ranged setup for the airborne form.

body:
# Kalphite Queen (airborne form)

Phase 2 airborne form has Protect from Melee active as defence only. Tumeken's shadow can zero-switch both phases; otherwise ranged is preferred.
